title: UNIMPRESSED
text: I've never given a one star review in my life, accept now. I've ordered before & wasn't impressed. That was a couple years ago. Ordered again 2 years later, NOT impressed. The kitties lost interest in the toys, within 10 minutes. The toys included were poor. You can buy less expensive kittie toys in any store, that are alot better. I cancelled my subscription. NOT again will I buy again from this: KitNipBox, company.
label: negative
